name: CS2 Trade-Up Dashboard -- Steam Session & Inventory Sync
description: Sends your Steam session cookie to your own locally-running CS2 Trade-Up dashboard (so the Rare Patterns scanner gets Steam's authenticated rate limit) and imports your CS2 inventory for the My Skins page -- works even on a private inventory. Nothing is sent anywhere except localhost.

action.default_title: Sync Steam session + import inventory to CS2 dashboard
